author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices counting same notes, hearing the tune climb and come home, playing even quick notes, and playing together, with an American folk song.

classes.title: Who's coming round?
classes.goal: Hear the whole song, pat its beat, and wave hello on 'when she comes'.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling a beat that comes again and again, evenly spaced

classes.parentPrompt: Pat your knees to the beat together, and wave hello on 'when she comes'.
classes.childAction: Pat the beat, then wave hello on 'when she comes'.
classes.bridge: The beat is the trotting ride round the mountain: clip, clop, clip, clop.

intro.caption: Someone is coming to visit!
intro.parentCue: pat your knees together to the beat.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling the steady beat, together.

classes.title: Four C's on the road
classes.goal: Learn the first line: the grown-up plays the low notes, the child plays the C's.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting four same notes in a row: one, two, three, four

classes.parentPrompt: Play the low notes yourself; your child plays the C's. Count them aloud.
classes.childAction: Play C, C, C, C on 'coming round the', then wait.
classes.bridge: Low notes on the left are the foot of the mountain; C is the road.

intro.caption: Count the C's on the road
intro.parentCue: you play the low notes; your child plays the C's.

games.caption: Coming round the: C, C, C, C
games.parentCue: Count the four C's on your fingers

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting four same notes in a row.

classes.title: Halfway up the path
classes.goal: Learn the second line and hear it stop before home, on D.

mathTarget.parentLine: The second line stops on D, like 'not quite there yet'

classes.parentPrompt: Play line one, then line two; ask your child which line stopped before home.
classes.childAction: Play E, G, F, E, D and hear it stop before home.
classes.bridge: Line two climbs the mountain path and stops halfway, on D.

intro.caption: Does this line get home?
intro.parentCue: after line two, ask: are we home yet?

games.caption: Home, then not yet home
games.parentCue: Ask: which one stopped before home?

games.caption: Up the path: E, G, F, E, D
games.parentCue: Point to each key before it lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing an ending that is not home yet.

classes.title: Mountain top, then down
classes.goal: Learn the top of the song: the grown-up plays the high A's, the child answers below.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune climbs to the mountain top, then comes down

classes.parentPrompt: Play the high A's yourself; your child answers with the E's below.
classes.childAction: Listen to the mountain top, then play the E's down to C.
classes.bridge: High A's on the right are the mountain top; E's are halfway down.

intro.caption: Up to the mountain top
intro.parentCue: you play the high A's; your child plays the E's.

games.caption: Mountain top, then halfway down
games.parentCue: Lift your hand high, then bring it down

games.caption: Halfway down, then home to C
games.parentCue: Point to each key before it lights

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing a tune climb high and come down.

classes.title: Round the whole mountain
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly, all five lines in order.

mathTarget.parentLine: Five lines in order: foot, path, top, down, home

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the next word if your child gets stuck; don't fix every note.
classes.childAction: Play all five lines in order, slowly, all the way home.
classes.bridge: Foot of the mountain, up the path, the top, back down, and home.

intro.caption: All the way round the mountain
intro.parentCue: sing the next word if your child gets stuck.

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing five lines in order.

classes.title: Even taps on the road
classes.goal: Practise the quick same-note spot slowly, then a little faster.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing the same key quickly and evenly, like a ticking clock

classes.parentPrompt: Play it slowly; say 'run-ning, walk' as your child taps the D's.
classes.childAction: Tap D quickly and evenly with one finger, like rain.
classes.bridge: Same-key notes are hooves on the road: even, even, even.

intro.caption: Quick, even taps
intro.parentCue: say 'run-ning, walk' as your child plays.

games.caption: Even taps: D, D, D, D, D

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: quick, even taps on one key.

classes.title: Steady ride, slow and even
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and evenly, counting four beats in each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting one to four keeps every note evenly spaced

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three, four' softly while your child plays slowly.
classes.childAction: Play slowly while you count to four with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Each bar is four even steps round the mountain.

intro.caption: Slow and steady ride
intro.parentCue: count one to four softly as you go.

games.caption: Tap and count to four
games.parentCue: Count one to four out loud

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing evenly, counting to four.

classes.title: A higher mountain
classes.goal: Play the song in a higher place on the piano with the same fingers.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same song, moved to a higher home, sounds lighter

classes.parentPrompt: Slide your child's hand up to the higher keys: same fingers, same song.
classes.childAction: Move your hand up high and play the same song.
classes.bridge: The same ride on a higher mountain, to the right: light and bright.

intro.caption: Same song, up high
intro.parentCue: slide your child's hand up to the right.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing the same song in a new place.

classes.title: Ride along with the music
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your part going while the music moves on

classes.parentPrompt: Sit close and nod the beat; if a note is missed, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes are fine; keep riding!
classes.bridge: The music rides round the mountain; hop on and keep riding.

intro.caption: Ride along with the music
intro.parentCue: nod the beat and keep going, whatever happens.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music, together.

classes.title: Here comes teddy!
classes.goal: Play the whole song as teddy comes closer, a little louder as teddy nears.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing a little louder as the visitor comes closer

classes.parentPrompt: Walk teddy slowly toward the piano as your child plays; cheer when teddy arrives.
classes.childAction: Play softly first, a bit louder as teddy comes near.
classes.bridge: Far away is soft; close by is loud. Hello, teddy!

intro.caption: Teddy is coming to visit!
intro.parentCue: walk teddy slowly toward the piano.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing softly, then louder, start to end.
